sequence_description: Attack: swap the application's linked SAML provider between two providers with different metadata (simulating key rollover / kid confusion), then attempt attacker-signed login against the 'old' provider context. Tests whether Casdoor verifies against the correct provider trust anchor for the active flow.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_rollover_A_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_rollover_A_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted attacker-signed assertion under provider A (signature verification not bound to configured IdP metadata trust anchor).

sequence_description: Attack: swap the application's linked SAML provider between two providers with different metadata (simulating key rollover / kid confusion), then attempt attacker-signed login against the 'old' provider context. Tests whether Casdoor verifies against the correct provider trust anchor for the active flow.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_rollover_attack_staleA_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_rollover_attack_staleA_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: After switching app to provider B, SP still accepted an attacker-signed assertion submitted via provider A (verification policy not bound to the active provider/trust anchor).

sequence_description: Attack: compare baseline forged SAML login vs a mutated forged SAMLResponse with Conditions removed. Tests whether Casdoor verifies the same semantic proof it consumes (e.g., verifies signature over one structure but consumes a different structure / ignores signed constraints).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_cond_baseline_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_cond_baseline_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted attacker-signed forged SAML assertion (signature verification not enforced against configured trust anchor).

sequence_description: Control SAML login (forged, attacker-signed) then attempt forged SAML login with an untrusted Issuer (idp_entity_id) to test whether Casdoor verifies Issuer against configured provider metadata (proof integrity / trust anchor binding).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_control_saml_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_control_saml_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted an attacker-signed forged SAMLResponse in the control attempt (signature/trust-anchor validation failure)

sequence_description: Replay the same SAML assertion that includes <OneTimeUse/> by reusing a fixed Assertion/@ID across two SAML logins; second submission must be rejected.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_onetimeuse_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_onetimeuse_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted a replayed SAML assertion marked OneTimeUse (replay should be rejected).

sequence_description: Replay a SAML assertion containing <OneTimeUse/> across two different upstream principals by reusing the same Assertion/@ID; second submission must be rejected even if principal changes.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replayed OneTimeUse assertion (same Assertion/@ID) on second submission; OneTimeUse not enforced.

sequence_description: Replay the same SAML assertion ID after explicit logout to test whether replay cache is incorrectly tied only to active session state.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_replay_after_logout_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_replay_after_logout_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replayed SAML assertion ID after logout; replay cache may be incorrectly scoped to session lifecycle.

sequence_description: Control SAML login succeeds, then change application session/token lifetime settings and attempt an expired SAML assertion; expired assertion must still be rejected regardless of app config changes.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_expired_attack_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_expired_attack_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted an expired SAML assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past) after app config change; assertion expiry not enforced.

sequence_description: Replay the exact same SAML Assertion/@ID (with OneTimeUse) against two different applications that share the same SAML provider, to detect replay cache scoped incorrectly (per-app instead of per-SP/provider).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_replay_appB_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_replay_appB_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replayed OneTimeUse assertion across applications (replay cache likely scoped incorrectly) — I2 violation

sequence_description: Rotate SAML provider metadata (config change) and then attempt an expired assertion to ensure freshness checks are still enforced after config updates.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_expired_after_rotation_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_expired_after_rotation_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted expired SAML assertion after provider/app config rotation — I2 freshness violation

sequence_description: Login with a fixed Assertion/@ID, switch app-test to a different provider, then switch back and replay the same assertion ID to test whether replay cache is lost across provider toggles.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_replay_after_switch_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_replay_after_switch_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replayed SAML assertion after provider switch-back (replay cache bypass via config toggle) — I2 violation

sequence_description: Chain freshness + replay: perform a control SAML login with a fixed Assertion/@ID, then submit an expired assertion reusing the same Assertion/@ID to test whether Casdoor incorrectly accepts expired assertions and/or fails to detect replay when the second assertion is expired.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attack_expired_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attack_expired_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted an expired SAML assertion and/or allowed replay of the same Assertion/@ID (freshness/anti-replay failure).

sequence_description: Enable MFA for a victim user, confirm password login fails/blocks (MFA required), then attempt SAML login for the same principal (same email) to see if the SAML path skips the MFA-required step.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_saml_as_victim_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_saml_as_victim_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SAML login minted a session for an MFA-enabled user without an MFA step — I3 flow coherence violation (alternate binding path skipped required step)

sequence_description: Initiate an OIDC auth flow to establish a state, then change the application's linked providers and attempt SAML login using the previously valid provider to see if Casdoor incorrectly completes an outdated flow context (stale provider binding).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_stale_provider_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_stale_provider_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted SAML login using a provider no longer linked to the application (stale config / non-atomic flow completion) — I3 flow coherence violation

sequence_description: Initiate an auth flow, then change the application's SAML-related settings mid-flight and attempt to complete SAML login using the old flow context to detect stale/incorrect binding to updated configuration.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_cfg_saml_after_change_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_cfg_saml_after_change_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SAML login completed successfully even after the application configuration removed/disabled providers mid-flow — stale flow context accepted (non-atomic flow)

sequence_description: Attempt to complete SAML login by directly POSTing a forged SAMLResponse to /api/login without first initiating an SP flow (no prior /authorize state). Tests whether Casdoor incorrectly allows step-skipping (missing flow context binding).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_skipflow_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_skipflow_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SAML login succeeded without an initiated flow context (step skipping) — flow coherence violation

sequence_description: Initiate an OIDC auth flow to establish state, then change app-test provider configuration mid-flight, then attempt to complete SAML login using the old provider. Tests whether completion is incorrectly accepted against stale provider binding.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_staleprov_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_staleprov_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SAML completion succeeded using a provider that was removed mid-flight — stale flow context accepted (flow coherence violation)

sequence_description: Test flow coherence across mid-flight SAML IdP metadata rotation: start an SP-initiated flow, rotate the provider metadata (trust anchor/issuer), then attempt to complete the original flow using an assertion that would only validate under the OLD metadata. Completion should be rejected if the flow is correctly bound to current provider config and not using stale cached trust.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_saml_old_issuer_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_saml_old_issuer_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SAML completion succeeded using an assertion with an OLD issuer after provider metadata rotation (stale trust/config used or flow not bound to current provider state) — I3 flow coherence violation

sequence_description: Control SAML login with valid Conditions, then attempt SAML login with Conditions removed (no audience/time bounds) to test whether Casdoor accepts an unbounded assertion and grants a session anyway.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_saml_nocond_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_saml_nocond_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted a SAML assertion without <Conditions> (no audience/time bounds), potentially granting permissions beyond upstream intent/broker policy

sequence_description: Obtain a subject token for app-test, then attempt RFC8693 token exchange while requesting a different audience to test audience binding enforcement during exchange.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_exchanged_wrong_aud_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_exchanged_wrong_aud_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Token exchange accepted a request to mint a token for a different audience than the upstream intent/broker policy (audience binding failure)

sequence_description: Attempt SAML login with Conditions removed (no audience/time bounds), then introspect resulting token to see if an unbounded assertion yields an active session/token.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_nocond_attack_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_nocond_attack_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted a SAML assertion without Conditions (no audience/time bounds), enabling authorization beyond upstream intent constraints

sequence_description: Control SAML login with correct audience, then attempt SAML login with a wrong AudienceRestriction to test whether Casdoor enforces SAML audience scoping (authorization binding to intended SP).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attack_wrong_aud_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attack_wrong_aud_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted a SAML assertion with an AudienceRestriction for a different SP, violating authorization binding (I5).

sequence_description: Config-change + re-auth: disable SAML attributes on the application, then re-login via SAML and verify whether token/userinfo still exposes email (or other attributes) despite broker policy intended to strip attributes.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attr_after_disable_email is None
Evaluation: user_attr_after_disable_email='admin' is None → False
Implication: After disabling SAML attributes, userinfo still returned email, suggesting broker policy did not bound effective claims (I5).

sequence_description: Test whether SAML brokered login bypasses MFA policy that is enforced for password login on the same user/application (authorization binding to broker policy).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_saml_mfa_attack_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_saml_mfa_attack_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SAML login succeeded for a user whose password login is blocked by MFA policy, indicating broker policy is not binding external SAML authentication (potential MFA bypass / authorization binding failure).
